verdict.rationale: Brex exposes a broad public API (transactions, budgets, expenses, users, webhooks) and an official MCP server for AI-assistant access, covering many core UI workflows, but there is no evidence of full parity — e.g. no documented API for bill pay approval routing, travel policy management, or card issuance settings that mirror the UI feature set. missing for 10: explicit parity statement, bill-pay/travel/card-management API endpoints, independent confirmation that all UI actions are API-reachable.
